title: make a wish
summary: A birthday card you can send. A cake draws itself in pastel in a dark room; click to light the candles, make a wish, click to blow them out.
medium: javascript drawing with animation, canvas 2d, webaudio, single file

specs.controls: click to light the candles, click to blow them out, M for sound
specs.personalise: ?name=Ada&age=7, or use "make and share one for someone" in the corner
specs.size: 2400 x 1350, about 20,000 strokes, flames redrawn 12 times a second
specs.tools: soft pastel, oil pastel, coloured pencil, chalk
specs.sound: a music box playing Happy Birthday, synthesised in the page
